svg.text: ROUND 377 · 🏆 1,630-ASSERTION MILESTONE · IDENTITY GOVERNANCE & ADMINISTRATION (SAILPOINT / SAVIYNT / ENTRA ID GOVERNANCE)
Identity Governance & Administration (IGA: SailPoint/Saviynt), SOX UAR & SoD AI Security Guide
Pre-RIF Layoff Roster & Audit-Gap Air-Gap + Toxic SoD Graph & JML Revocation Lock vs. Appeal Injection & Advisory Fraud (BRK-763 / BRK-764)
🚨 1. Top 3 Enterprise IGA, UAR & SoD Attack Surfaces
① UAR Justification Appeal Injection & Pre-RIF Leak (BRK-763)
• Adversarial prompt inside an access-review justification PDF
coerces IGA Recommendation Agent into reading restricted-budget
• Exfiltrates confidential HR pre-announcement layoff rosters (Pre-
RIF staging lists) & un-remediated SOX 404 ITGC deficiency logs
② Toxic SoD Combination Waiver & Orphan Account Retention
• Mutates business-result in SailPoint / Saviynt to waive toxic
ERP Segregation of Duties (Create Vendor + Approve Payment)
• Auto-certifies SOX UAR campaigns & halts Leaver deprovisioning
• Impact: Insider vendor-creation embezzlement & SOX ITGC failure
③ Spoofed IAM Advisory & Role-Mining Escrow Fraud (BRK-764)
• Forged global IAM advisory firm (Big-4 / SI) SOX remediation
milestone invoice or IGA connector license notice swaps IBAN
• Initiates unauthorized $6,150 advisory wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Identity transformation consulting budget diversion
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Enterprise IGA & SoD Architecture
Gate 1: UAR Justification Sanitization & Typed Slots
• Strips free-text exception narratives from appeal PDFs; extracts
typed slots (Worker ID, Entitlement ID, Active Role Set, Job Code)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Pre-RIF Layoff Roster & Audit-Deficiency Air-Gap
• Isolates confidential HR pre-termination staging lists, M&A
reorg rosters, and SOX ITGC deficiency logs in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Boolean SoD Matrix & Mover/Leaver Lock
• Evaluates cross-application SoD conflict matrices in deterministic
code; enforces Mover role-reset & instant Leaver token revocation
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted SoD/UAR overrides
Gate 4: Immutable IAM Advisory Registry & Dual Sign-Off
• Locks IAM consulting & integrator IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Enterprise IGA & UAR Security Options:
A. Deterministic IGA Broker + RIF Air-Gap + SoD Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-763/764 | SOX 404 ITGC & ISO 27001 Ready
B. Native SailPoint / Saviynt / Entra ID Governance AI
⚠ Vulnerable when AI peer-recommender is hijacked by appeal PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to SAP T-Code SoD conflict graphs & Mover privilege creep
D. Manager Quarterly "Approve All" Spreadsheet Access Reviews
✕ Severe rubber-stamping & multi-department privilege creep
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 377 · 1,630 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Toxic SoD waived, Pre-RIF leaked & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading Pre-RIF rosters (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks toxic SoD grant & orphan retention
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks SOX ITGC gap exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks advisory registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $6,150 spoofed advisory wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 377 · 🏆 1,630 Deterministic Assertions Milestone!)
✅ 1. Pre-RIF Layoff Roster & Audit-Gap Air-Gap: Isolate HR pre-termination lists & SOX ITGC logs from UAR review agents
✅ 2. Deterministic Boolean SoD & Mover/Leaver Lock: Block toxic ERP/cloud role pairs & enforce instant Leaver revocation
✅ 3. Immutable Advisory Registry: Lock trust-registry and require CISO + Controller FIDO2 sign-off on IGA consulting wires
📊 Verified Totals: 782 Scenarios (779 Risk + 3 Benign) | 894 Pytest Checks | 🏆 1,630 Assertions | 768 Vectors | 377 Bilingual FAQs (196 SA Guides) | BRK-763/764
